dict.string: GhostWriter needs microphone access to transcribe your speech into text.
GhostWriter needs accessibility access to detect the Right Option key and inject text at your cursor.
GhostWriter needs system audio recording access to transcribe the other participants in your meetings.
GhostWriter uses on-device speech recognition as an offline fallback when the transcription service is unreachable.
GhostWriter reads the active browser tab's address to pick the right writing style (e.g. email style on Gmail). You can disable this in Settings.
GhostWriter adds your meeting action items to the Reminders app when you choose to export them.
